shows.title: Wicked
not_for: people who want edgy or minimalist theater
shows.review_summary: Long-running crowd-pleaser. Praised for huge songs, staging and the central friendship; some find the plot familiar.

shows.title: Harry Potter and the Cursed Child
shows.review_summary: Loved for magic tricks and staging; story is more divisive and leans on knowing the books.

shows.title: The Book of Mormon
shows.review_summary: Famously very funny with catchy songs. Audiences either love the crude humor or leave offended.

shows.title: & Juliet
shows.review_summary: Pop-hit-packed romp that reimagines Juliet's story. Fans love the energy; critics of jukebox shows find the plot thin.

shows.title: Hadestown
good_for: people who like moody, poetic shows
shows.review_summary: Atmospheric retelling of a Greek myth with a standout score. Some find it somber and slow.

shows.title: Maybe Happy Ending
good_for: people who like small, tender stories
shows.review_summary: Intimate robot love story that audiences describe as sweet and moving. NOTE: listed as closing Nov 22, 2026, so check dates.
